text:
Type: square drop-leaf dining table
Use: dining, extra seating when needed; kitchen, small dining room
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: solid oak with a clear finish, visible joinery
Colors: light warm oak
Shape: square top with two hinged drop leaves, exposed joints at the top of the legs, four thick legs splayed slightly outward, sturdy and crafted, medium visual weight
Feel: crafted, warm, honest, timeless
Goes with: oak or black chairs, white or greige walls, linen; Scandinavian, Japandi or mid-century dining rooms

product.name: MCKELBY
product.description: Table with a top layer of solid wood, a hardwearing natural material that can be sanded and surface treated when required.
